task: verify r23sb-3 (dummy gate line for SEC stacks exp82a-c and SEC+CI/CI stacks exp83c-g)
reason: The premise is true. CONTEXT.md has no gate line for exp82* or exp83c-g, because R22-A1 (01:48Z) names only exp83a/b. W2 v4 (2)(v) and W4 AMEND 2 (1) require a PASSED dummy, so without a gate line 'PASSED' is undefined for exactly the files W3/W4 would use. The line adds no mechanism, no slot and no knob, so R8 does not apply. It can still be written before any output exists: scan_hyp_stack_builds.json (04:15Z) says all 9 files are built and 'dummy NOT yet run'. The kernel metadata is right: exp82a-c and exp83c/d/e/g attach biohub-secft-n2a-v1, and exp83c-g attach coord-inject. The value is procedural only (it stops a broken stack from reaching W3/W4), not an LB lever. The proposal as written has two defects and one gap. (1) Part (b) cites R22-A1 (1)-(3), (5) and (6) but OMITS (4), the 7-column topology identity check, even though it names a 'topology sibling'. (4) is the check that proves CI touched only z/y/x, so a CI stack that changed topology would still PASS. (2) Part (a)'s node band (-0.5%..+0.2% vs the non-SEC sibling 121,252) is loose and anchored to the wrong file. The local dummy CSVs in _dl/ show that cap/fc/fm knobs never change nodes. Every non-SEC dummy (exp58/70b/70g/78a/78b/83a) has 121,252 nodes. Every ed8c616b SEC dummy (exp72 K2, exp79d cap6, exp76d fm45) has 121,061. By pandas, the node rows (dataset,node_id,t,z,y,x) are IDENTICAL for exp72 vs exp79d and for exp70g vs exp78b. So an exp82x built from a correct n2a secondary must reproduce exp81's node rows exactly (121,085); any deviation means the wrong weights or a broken build. (3) The exp81 and exp80a dummy CSVs are NOT downloaded (_dl/ has only 78a/78b/79a/79d/83a/83b), and they are the siblings for exp82c, exp83c and exp83f. Gating those files first needs a download plus a sha12 match to the logged 8132ef2811d0 / a109ad024ace. With these fixes the line is sound and should be written now.
fix: Append ONE line to CONTEXT.md before any exp82x/exp83c-g dummy is pushed (or, if an output was already listed, add R22-A1's '(written after the output was listed; criteria are mechanical and fixed by the sibling CSVs)'). The line reads: 'SEC/SEC+CI STACK DUMMY GATE (round 23, r23sb-3 as amended). (a) exp82a/b/c (non-SEC siblings exp78a/exp78b/exp80a) PASS iff (1) validate ok; (2) 0 Traceback/FAILED/DEADLINE:/FALLING BACK; (3) the log shows Secondary SHA256 7029fe69 from /kaggle/input/.../biohub-secft-n2a-v1; (4) node rows (dataset,node_id,t,z,y,x), sorted by id, are identical to the exp81 dummy CSV (121,085 nodes); lab basis: cap/fc knobs leave node rows unchanged (exp72 vs exp79d, exp70g vs exp78b identical); (5) the CSV differs from both the non-SEC sibling and exp81 (edges/forks change with the cap), with edges and forks logged; (6) runtime <= 1,920 s. (b) exp83c/d/e/f/g PASS iff R22-A1 (1), (2), (3), (5) and (6) hold AND (4'): the 7 columns id,dataset,row_type,node_id,t,source_id,target_id are identical to the sibling dummy CSV, with the counts taken from that CSV. Pairs: exp83c-exp81, exp83d-exp82b, exp83e-exp82a, exp83f-exp80a, exp83g-exp82c. For the SEC+CI pairs, also check that Secondary SHA256 7029fe69 appears. (c) Before gating, download the exp81 and exp80a dummy outputs into _dl/ and match CSV sha12 8132ef2811d0 / a109ad024ace; on a mismatch, do not gate. exp83d/e/g are gated only after their exp82 sibling PASSES. (d) exp84a stays under R21-A3 (e) cap-rung rules (validate ok, 0 errors) plus node rows identical to exp70g. A FAIL means W3/W4 skip that stack (W2 v4 (2)(v), W4 AMEND 2 (1)).' Order the pushes by what W3/W4 can actually use: exp83c and exp83f can be gated today. Push exp82a/b first, because they unlock exp83d/e.
realistic_gain: 0 on the LB by itself: it is a process line, not a lever. It prevents a mis-built SEC/CI stack (wrong weights, CI touching topology) from taking a scarce W3/W4 slot. The exact node-row check against exp81 catches a wrong or missing n2a secondary that the proposed -0.5/+0.2% band could miss (the ed8c616b secondary gives 121,061 = -0.16%, inside the band). Cost is about 15 minutes of main-session time plus the dummy GPU runs that were already planned.
